thread:
people-ops: Heads up 1 quick org note: Rebecca Stone is joining Redwood as Director, Platform Reliability, start date 2026-05-04. She'll take ownership of reliability, observability SLAs, and incident playbooks. Diego will transition platform reliability duties to Rebecca over the next 6 weeks. :tada:

Aisha Patel: Amazing news 1 huge welcome to Rebecca! Recruiting: we'll open two Sr Eng Manager backfills (reliability + observability) and one PM II (new role) to support prioritization and runbook work.

Evan Carter: Quick finance check 1 are the Eng Manager slots net-new or backfills? Need to know for Q3 planning.

people-ops: Evan 1 both Eng Manager roles are backfills (reassigned from existing platform headcount). PM II is an approved new slot. HC codes: ENG-PLAT-011, ENG-PLAT-012 (backfills); PM-PLAT-020 (new).

Diego Morales: Rebecca's been a collaborator for a while 1 excited for the handoff. I'll prepare a handoff doc listing open projects, pager commitments, and customer-facing items. Aim to complete handoff by 2026-06-15.

Rebecca Stone: Hi team 1 thrilled to join Redwood. First priorities: (1) triage and reduce high-severity alert noise, (2) codify observability SLAs and dashboards, (3) improve incident commander rotations and runbook automation. I'll set 1:1s with on-call leads next week.

Lina Chavez: Welcome Rebecca! I'll schedule a 30-min intro with infra/runtime for Tue and coordinate shadowing on the next two rotations.

Priya Natarajan: For the manager backfills 1 do we run internal referrals first? There are some strong engineerruntime candidates I can recommend.

Aisha Patel: Yes, internal first. Hiring plan: week 1 internal screens, week 2 onsites (panel: eng lead, reliability SME, product partner, people-ops). I'll add owners in Greenhouse today.

HiringBot: Reminder: create interview rubrics in Greenhouse and tag "Platform Reliability". Due: 2026-04-10.

Evan Carter: Rebecca 1 any specific competencies you want emphasized in interviews for the Eng Manager roles?

Rebecca Stone: Focus on incident management, postmortem rigor, automation of runbooks, and experience scaling observability for high-throughput services. Also look for people who've automated on-call rotations and reduced MTTD.

people-ops: Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.company/onboarding/checklists/platform-reliability. Please drop any team-specific notes into the "Rebecca Stone onboarding" folder.

Aisha Patel: Compensation note: Director band L6. Relocation evaluated case-by-case. People-ops will draft offers with total comp ranges.

Diego Morales: I'll publish a short customer-impact brief for any outstanding action items that need exec visibility before the handoff.

Rebecca Stone: Thanks Diego. Looking forward to meeting everyone 1 DMs open to set up 1:1s.

Lina Chavez: :thumbsup: We'll coordinate shadowing windows and the first two incident rotations.

people-ops: Action items recap: Aisha to post reqs today; HiringBot will ping for rubrics; Rebecca to share 1:1 schedule by next Tue; Diego to publish transition doc by 2026-05-15. Congratulations and welcome Rebecca! :confetti_ball:
